incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: P1 - eu-west-2b high RPC timeout rate (rpc_timeout_rate > 0.12). Trigger: net-fabric-euw2b. PD incident: PD567890
Marcus (oncall): Acked in PD, I'm on it. Starting quick triage.
pd-integration: PagerDuty note: PD567890 acknowledged by Marcus (oncall).
Elena SRE: Loading fabric and node metrics. Seeing flapping routes and kubelet reconnects in eu-west-2b around 20:14 UTC. Autoscaler reacting to perceived capacity drop -> creates and removes nodes rapidly.
Rahul Infra: Confirming. There's a control-plane <-> node keepalive spike and titanium-switch logs show BGP flap on leaf-12.
Amy Support: Any customer-facing failures? Support dashboard shows 7 tenants with increased 502/504 from embedding and streaming endpoints in eu-west-2.
RuntimeLead: Recommending immediate protective measures: 1) pause autoscaling in eu-west-2b pools, 2) divert new session creation away from 2b to 2a/c, 3) enable request throttling for non-enterprise plans.
Marcus (oncall): Pausing autoscaler for pools dedicated-gpu-pool-euw2b. Command:
```
infractl autoscaler --pool dedicated-gpu-pool-euw2b --action pause --note "incident PD567890"
```
Marcus (oncall): Applying routing override to prefer eu-west-2c for new sessions. Policy name: region-failover-eu-west2c. Applying for 20m window.
incident-bot: Route override applied: region-failover-eu-west2c. Selector: !tag("enterprise") OR route.priority < 150. Estimated traffic shift: ~55%.
Elena SRE: Starting node pin for healthy nodes to prevent churn. Running:
```
kubectl label nodes gpu-node-21 euw2-stable=true
kubectl annotate nodes gpu-node-21 maint/keep=true
```
Rahul Infra: Networking team alerted, investigating BGP adjacency. Meanwhile, I'm marking leaf-12 for reboot window. Reboot command scheduled via infra-schedule: reboot leaf-12 at 20:40 UTC.
Amy Support: Logged affected customers: acct-1203 (embeddings), acct-1402 (chat streaming), acct-1507 (batch inference). Drafting status update: short note about degraded performance and mitigation steps.
RuntimeLead: Also starting a quantized fallback for heavy embed routes in eu-west-2c to absorb extra load. Command:
```
redwoodctl deploy --model embed-xfmr:quant-v1 --region eu-west-2c --replicas 6 --config "batch.max_tokens=512"
```
Elena SRE: After pause, autoscaler activity drops to zero. RPC timeouts reduce slowly but still elevated. Adding prefix-caching for conversational endpoints to shave GPU work.
Marcus (oncall): PD escalated to SRE lead after 10 minutes. Handing primary to Elena SRE. @Elena SRE you're owning mitigation.
Elena SRE: Taking over. Mitigation plan summary: pause autoscaler, route override, node pin, prefix caching, quantized fallback. Next: observe for 15m then decide on cross-region failover if fabric not restored.
Rahul Infra: Networking: BGP flap confirmed due to control-plane overload on leaf-12 — we're throttling route updates and planning a staged restart on the leaf. ETA 12-15m.
incident-bot: Incident PD567890 status -> Mitigated (partial). Keep incident open for RCA. Runbook referenced: /runbooks/net-fabric-flap.json
Amy Support: Sent interim customer notifications for acct-1203 and acct-1402. Waiting on acct-1507 response for 1:1.
RuntimeLead: Observed p95 latency on eu-west-2c under new load is within SLO for most models; embedding throughput looks healthy after quantized deploy.
Marcus (oncall): Adding a temporary circuit-breaker for high-concurrency embed jobs hitting eu-west-2 until fabric fully stable. Command:
```
redwoodctl config set control.circuit_breaker.embed_concurrency --region eu-west-2 --value 200
```
Elena SRE: Good call. Also adding a smoke test to validate node stability post-reboot. Will capture kernel and kubelet logs for RCA.
Marta (night-oncall): I'll take the handoff in 35m. Please leave final notes in incident doc and include commands + timestamps.
pd-integration: PagerDuty update: PD567890 acknowledged -> Mitigated (partial). Notes appended.
Elena SRE: Post-incident notes for PM: probable root cause is control-plane/leaf overload causing BGP flaps and node keepalive failures; consequences include autoscaler thrash and session routing instability. Immediate fixes: pause autoscaler, route override, pin stable nodes, staged reboot of leaf-12, deploy quantized fallback and caching. Action items: 1) increase control-plane rate limits and backoff on leafs, 2) add autoscaler debounce logic to avoid reacting to transient network blurts, 3) create simulated fabric-flap smoke test in staging, 4) customer outreach template for impacted customers.
Marcus (oncall): Time to mitigation (partial): 12m. Keeping PD open until fabric confirmed stable and autoscaler resume tested. Great coordination, team. :thumbsup:
Amy Support: Final on this thread: sent consolidated update to all affected customers and scheduled follow-ups.
Elena SRE: I'll drop the full timeline and commands into the incident doc now and tag SRE leads for RCA follow-up.
Marta (night-oncall): Acknowledged, will pick up and run post-mitigation checks at handoff.
incident-bot: Incident PD567890 -> Open (monitoring). RCA required.
